description: A request for a hosted Suite workspace. Signups through the public API confirm their email with a one-time code; a request created here is taken on the operator's word and processed at once. Either way the owner is invited from the new site and chooses their own password.

fields.description: Gets the one-time code and the owner invite. The part before @ names the owner account on the site.
fields.label: Email

fields.description: Names the workspace, e.g. Acme Inc. The label is made from it if not given.
fields.label: Organization

fields.description: Names the site and mail domains, e.g. acme. Leave blank to make it from the organization.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Site time zone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Blank keeps the site default.
fields.label: Time Zone

fields.description: Pending: waits for the email code. Verified: the code is correct. Processing: setting up the tenant and site. Completed: site ready and owner invited. Failed: stopped on an error, run Retry. Expired: no code in 24 hours.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Verified
Processing
Completed
Failed
Expired

fields.description: Time from email confirmation to owner invite, with waits and retries.
fields.label: Processing Time

fields.description: Secret to read the request status through the signup API. Shown once.
fields.label: Request Key

fields.description: Address the signup came from. Blank for requests made in the desk.
fields.label: IP Address

fields.description: The request expires at this time if the code is not entered.
fields.label: Expires At

fields.description: Each step from request to owner invite, with its duration.
fields.label: Steps

name: Suite Tenant Request
